option_relations.rationale: Post-viral keratitis is a broader term that encompasses various types of keratitis caused by viral infections, including Chikungunya virus-associated keratitis and post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis.
Post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis is a specific type of keratitis that matches the description of the leaf labels.
